method: Every emitted detection was judged by eye (single reviewer: the AI assistant that implemented the tracker) on frames decoded by the app's own video element, as overlay sheets with the reference circles. 'wrong' = the circle is not on the target ball. Not independent of the implementation.

notes.detector: All detections on the active ball, including the red-kit and multi-ball scenes. Tennis: six detections before the scene cut, all on the ball; nothing after the cut. Topdown: the single detection is the 10 px ball at the seed frame.
notes.colour: Training: only frame 0 is on the ball; the other 12 detections are rooftop and background patches (the original colour-tracker failure). Tennis: seven pre-cut detections, all on the ball; nothing after the cut. Aerial, topdown, improvised and tournament were refused at selection.
notes.detector-without-size-rule: Tennis only, with the size-continuity rule disabled: after the hard cut at frame 8 the track reacquired an orange-and-white traffic cone at the bottom of the frame with scores 0.25-0.75, 16 detections (frames 10, 12, 14, 17-29).
